<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Riiight? You’ll stop caring what others think when you

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh... Is that so?

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? Uh... <$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>, is that <$cdef(27)><$cname(69)> behind you? <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>They’re

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I do not know. Maybe because I eat many sparkling gems.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Their gradient color is nice. And their smoothness. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>But.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>A sua cor de gradiente é agradável e a sua suavidade. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Mas.

sob ataque...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yooo, you have such a good sound, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune. It really,
like, pulls at my heartstrings ’n’ stuff.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>What’s the secret to makin’ such a pretty sound?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yooo, você tem um som tão bom, <$cdef(27)>KricketuneÉ mesmo.
como, puxa para o meu coração’n’ coisas.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Qual é o segredo para fazer um som tão bonito?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm, good question. First, lemme hear your sound.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Boa pergunta, primeiro deixa-me ouvir o teu som.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Y-yeah, sure! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Tot... Tot... Tot...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... I dunno, yo. It just sounds like it lacks a bit of a
punch or somethin’.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, claro! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Tot... tot... tot... tot...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Não sei, parece que lhe falta um pouco...
soco ou algo assim.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! What’s wrong with that? Sounds cute to me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! O que há de errado com isso? Parece fofo para mim!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Heyyy! Don’t make fun of my sound... This is a super
serious issue for me, yo!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Heyyy! Não tire sarro do meu som... Este é um super
É um problema sério para mim, meu!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Whoa, sorry, pal! I didn’t mean it like that.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>See, I can’t make that sound anymore, so I’m kinda jealous
of ya.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Whoa, desculpe, amigo! Eu não quis dizer isso assim.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Veja, Eu não posso fazer esse som mais, então eu estou meio ciumento
De ti.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>H-huh? YOU’RE jealous of ME?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>H-huh? Você está com ciúmes de mim?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! Guess the grass is always greener, huh?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>But it’s pretty fun tinkerin’ around to make your own tune.
If you can’t make a certain sound, try to work around it
and keep striving <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>to produce one you DO want.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>By the time you’re done, you’ll have your very own, unique
sound!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Acho que a relva é sempre mais verde, não é?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>Mas é muito divertido mexer em torno de fazer a sua própria música.
Se você não pode fazer um certo som, tente trabalhar em torno dele
E continuai a lutar, <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>para produzir um que você quer.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>No momento em que você terminar, você terá o seu próprio, único
Som!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yooo! Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune! I think I understand! <$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m gonna
work hard to find my own ideal sound, just like you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Obrigado. <$cdef(27)>KricketuneAcho que compreendo! <$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Eu vou
trabalhar duro para encontrar o meu próprio som ideal, assim como você!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Dartrix! You’re always so cool and composed and...
y’know, cool!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Dartrix! Você é sempre tão legal e composto e...
sabe, fixe!

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh. You’re not wrong.
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh. Você não está errado.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Are you even like that in battle?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Você é mesmo assim em batalha?!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,5)>Of course. I start off by closely observing my opponents’
movements...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,5)>Claro. Começo observando de perto meus oponentes’
movimentos...

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Uh-huh, uh-huh.
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Uh-huh, uh-huh.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)>Then I instantly intuit where my opponent will be and what
they will do in the very next second. And then...
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>I strike them down with a single blow!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)>Então eu instantaneamente intuit onde meu oponente estará e o que
Eles vão fazê-lo no próximo segundo e depois...
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>Acertei-os com um único golpe!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>So cool!!!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Tão legal!!!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>That’s the secret to winning a battle without breaking a
sweat—it all comes down to using your head.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Esse é o segredo para ganhar uma batalha sem quebrar um
suor – tudo se resume a usar a cabeça.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>My head?! I’m SO good at using my head, yo! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I once
knocked out 30 opponents in a row with just Headbutt!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>Minha cabeça?! Eu sou tão bom em usar minha cabeça, yo! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Uma vez.
nocauteou 30 oponentes seguidos com apenas Headbutt!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Well... I guess there are lots of ways to use your head, huh.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Bem... acho que há muitas maneiras de usar a tua cabeça.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Hey, bud. That’s a sturdy-lookin’ head ya got there.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Ei, amigo. Essa é uma cabeça resistente-looking 'você tem lá.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Wh-whoa... What’s with the sudden cooompliment? I think
I’m blushiiing...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>O que é que se passa com a súbita cooompliment?
Estou corando...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>We gotta have a battle! Let’s see if your head is any match
against my pulverizing headbutt!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Temos de ter uma batalha! Vamos ver se a sua cabeça é qualquer correspondência
contra a minha cabeça pulsante!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Whaaat? H-hey... You’re making a scaaary face...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Whaaat? H-hey... Você está fazendo uma cara escamosa...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>HERE I COME! GRAHHHR!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>Aqui vou eu!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>H-heyyy...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>H-eyyy...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>Uuugh, that really surpriiised me... And it kinda hurt?
It’s been a whiiile since something hurt me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>Isso surpreendeu-me e doeu-me?
Tem sido um whiiile desde que algo me magoou.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Oof...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,18)>Can’t remember the last time I’ve felt this much pain...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Oof...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,18)>Não me lembro da última vez que senti tanta dor...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Ummm... Are we comparing who’s strooonger?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>’Cause if so, I guess it’s myyy turn next? OK, I won’t
hold baaack...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Ummm... Estamos comparando quem é estrooonger?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>‘Porque se sim, eu acho que é minha vez próxima? OK, Eu não vou
Espera, baaack...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)>W-wait, no! Ummm...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Y-ya know what? I just remembered—it’s about time for
some grub... Guess we’ll have to stop here for today!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)>Espera, não!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Y-você sabe o quê? Acabei de me lembrar - é sobre o tempo para
um pouco de comida... Acho que teremos que parar aqui por hoje!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Now then, I shall begin...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Agora, então, vou começar...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Yeah! Bring it on, yo!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Vamos lá, meu!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato-to-tooo! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato-to-tooo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Cha!!! <wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato chato! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Cha!! <wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato Chato!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)>Chatotooo... TOT! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)>Chatotooo... tot!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Not bad... Not bad at all! A most excellent jam session.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Nada mal, nada mal, uma excelente sessão de geleia.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe! Don’t underestimate me, yo! And you were pretty
awesome yourself!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe! Não me subestime, yo! E você foi bonito
Que maravilha!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,814)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You’re doing well, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. I see definite improvement.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Next, let’s work on refining your aura. Quietly now... Feel
the power inside you...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,814)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Você está indo bem, <$cdef(27)>RioluVejo uma melhoria definitiva.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Em seguida, vamos trabalhar em refinar sua aura. Silenciosamente agora... Sinta
O poder dentro de ti...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>*pant pant* Y-yes, Sensei!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Y-yes, Sensei!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$emotion(2,14)>... ... ...Ah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Heh heh, why don’t we get you something to eat, <$cdef(27)>Riolu.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$emotion(2,14)>... ......Ah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Heh heh, por que nós não lhe demos algo para comer, <$cdef(27)>Riolu.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>...Huh?
... ... ... *rumble*
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)>Oh!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>...Huh?
... ... ... * Rumble *
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)>Oh!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh! It appears you’ve been concentrating so hard, you
didn’t even notice you were hungry.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh! Parece que você tem se concentrado tão duro, você
nem percebeu que estava com fome.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>I can’t believe you had to notice for me, Sensei... I’m
so embarrassed! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>I’m really sorry!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Eu não posso acreditar que você tinha que notar para mim, Sensei... Eu sou
Que vergonha! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Sinto muito mesmo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>There’s no need to be embarrassed, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Let’s get you
fed so you can start afresh on a full stomach!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Ah—one moment. We have nothing here to eat. So that
will be the next step in your training! Find some berries!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Do you think you can handle that, <$cdef(27)>Riolu?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Não há necessidade de se envergonhar, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Vamos pegar você
alimentado para que você possa começar de novo com o estômago cheio!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Um momento, não temos nada aqui para comer.
será o próximo passo em seu treinamento! Encontre algumas bagas!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Achas que consegues lidar com isso? <$cdef(27)>Riolu?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yes, Sensei! I’ll do my best so I can be like you someday!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Sim, Sensei! Vou fazer o meu melhor para que eu possa ser como você algum dia!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Reading the mind of one’s opponent and then outwitting
them—that is the true essence of battle.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Lendo a mente do oponente e, em seguida, superando
eles – essa é a verdadeira essência da batalha.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,46)>Yeah, you seem like you’d be pretty good at that sorta
thing. I’d love to figure out how to do that myself.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,46)>Sim, você parece que você seria muito bom nesse tipo de
coisa. Eu adoraria descobrir como fazer isso eu mesmo.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Heh heh. Well then, how about a bit of training?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Então, que tal um pouco de treino?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Seriously? Heck yeah! Let’s do it!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Sério? Heck yeah! Vamos fazê-lo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>In that case... In a moment, I will throw either a punch or
a kick. <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Try to predict which it will be.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Nesse caso... num momento, dou um murro ou...
Um pontapé. <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Tente prever qual será.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Gotcha! OK, let’s see...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,815)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Got it! You’re gonna kick!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Peguei! OK, vamos ver...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,815)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Já está!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m afraid not.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Receio que não.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)>Nooo! Thought I had it for sure...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)>Pensei que o tinha de certeza...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Well then, what do you predict I’ll unleash next?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Bem, então, o que você prediz que eu vou liberar a seguir?

dialogues.en:

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,22)>Eu vou te mostrar que sou mais forte, mesmo que você seja maior!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Why, thank you, dear! I’m sure you could do it too if you

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Por que, obrigado, querida! Tenho certeza que você poderia fazê-lo também se você

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Ya really think so? OK, I’ll give it a go! Ahem...

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>E acabar por confundir os vizinhos...

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>That’s amazing! I wonder if I could do it too.<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,664)> OK, I wanna

<$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>! <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>Então eu vou começar a copiar você às vezes.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>’Cause I ate all the berries I had saved up.<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)> My poor
cheeks just felt super empty, so...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Porque eu comi todas as frutas que tinha economizado.<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)> Meu pobre.
As bochechas pareciam super vazias, por isso...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Oh darn. Maybe you should just train real hard <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,6)>so you can

<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Try openin’ your mouth REAL wide! Like this!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Talvez devesses treinar muito. <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,6)>para que possas
Manter mais bagas lá no futuro?
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Tente abrir’ sua boca REALmente larga! Assim!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,3)>Train? Ummm...<wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)> Like...this?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Yeah! Like that, yo! Now you just gotta stuff a bunch of
things in there.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>You gotta be willing to take on any challenge! Even if that
means chompin’ down on something bigger than you are!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Agora tem de fazer um monte de coisas.
As coisas lá dentro.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>tem de estar disposto a enfrentar qualquer desafio!
significa comer algo maior do que você!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmm, OK! I’m gonna try it!
<$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>So I just open my mouth reeeaaally wide? OK, here goes...
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Está bem, vou tentar!
<$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Então eu abro a minha boca bem larga?
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Y-yooo?! Don’t chomp ME!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Y-yooo?! Não me mastigar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,816)>*blang-blang-twang!* *blaaaang twang-TWANG!!!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Aw yeah! Another day, another tasty riff from yours truly!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,816)>* Blang-blang-twang!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Outro dia, outro riff saboroso do teu.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>I mean... It’s not bad, I guess...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>Quero dizer... não é ruim, eu acho...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,15)>Huh?! What’d you say?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,15)>O que você disse?!!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I just think you can do better...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Só acho que consegues fazer melhor...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>That’s big talk from a li’l pipsqueak!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,33)>Lay it on me, then. What can I do to make my riffs
even tastier?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Isso é uma grande conversa de um pipsqueak li’l!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,33)>O que posso fazer para fazer os meus riffs?
Mesmo mais saboroso?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>You don’t need so much strength in your fingers...
Make them go all relaxed, just like a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Also I think you need to work on your wrist movements...
They should be sharper, like when you use Poison Jab...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Você não precisa de tanta força em seus dedos...
Fazê-los ir todo relaxado, como um <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Também acho que precisas de trabalhar nos movimentos dos pulsos...
Devem ser mais afiados, como quando se usa o Jab Venenário...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$motionoff(1,661)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(1,661)><$emotion(2,48)>So...completely change my style? Easier said than done...
But sure, why not? I’ll give it a shot. <$voicel(2,6)>Let’s see...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,816)><$comeff(2,13)><$se2d(1043)>*bleowww wah wah-wah WAHHH!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Hey, heyyy! Now THAT’s a new sound!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$motionoff(1,661)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(1,661)><$emotion(2,48)>Então... mudar completamente o meu estilo?
Mas claro, por que não? Eu vou dar-lhe uma chance. <$voicel(2,6)>Vejamos...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,816)><$comeff(2,13)><$se2d(1043)>*bleowww wah wah-wah WAHHH!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Hey, heyyy! Agora que é um som novo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh heh... I knew you could do it...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu sabia que conseguias...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,5)>Say, bud! Uh...maybe you could swing by every now and
then to listen to me jam? <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,10)>Y’know, if ya feel like it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,5)>Talvez pudesses passar por cá de vez em quando e...
Então, para me ouvires tocar? <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,10)>Você sabe, se você quiser!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>Heh... Sure. Every now and then, anyway...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>Claro, de vez em quando...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>You and I are quite similar in appearance, but...the
flames that burn within us seem fairly different.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Tu e eu somos muito parecidos na aparência, mas...
As chamas que ardem dentro de nós parecem bastante diferentes.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Yeah... Your flames are so bright and strong... Just looking
at them makes my heart grow hot!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Sim... as tuas chamas são tão brilhantes e fortes...
com eles faz o meu coração ficar quente!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,4)>Really? Well, I think your flames possess a wonderful,
soothing quality.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,4)>Bem, acho que as tuas chamas possuem uma maravilhosa,
qualidade calmante.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>You...think so? Well, thank you. It makes me happy to hear
you say that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Bem, obrigado, fico feliz em saber que a minha mãe está a trabalhar.
Diz isso!

flames
do
you

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Yeah, I agree! I feel like it shows a fiery, passionate soul...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>It’s so cool!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Sim, eu concordo, sinto que mostra uma alma ardente e apaixonada...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>É tão legal!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)>That seems a bit exaggerated, but...thank you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)>Isso parece um pouco exagerado, mas... obrigado.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Heh. I knew you’d be able to appreciate their beauty. You
must desire peace of mind.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu sabia que você seria capaz de apreciar a beleza deles.
deve desejar paz de espírito.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)>W-well... I’m a bit embarrassed, but...thanks.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)>W-bem... Estou um pouco envergonhado, mas... obrigado.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>You and I may have our differences, but it seems we share
a desire for strength.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Podemos ter as nossas diferenças, mas parece que partilhamos
um desejo de força.
